ai.agentsHint: Each agent has its model, its tools and a versioned prompt. A company can use another model or turn tools off from its record.

err.model: Pick an active model that uses tools
err.number: Number greater than or equal to 0
err.imageModel: Choose an active model that edits images
err.name: Name is required
err.code: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscore (2 to 60)

ai.fallbackHint: Replies if the main one fails or takes too long.
ai.modelActiveHint: It cannot be turned off while an agent or a company uses it.
ai.modelNameHint: As the provider names it in its API.
ai.modelsHint: Prices in US$ per 1,000 tokens; they are used to compute the cost of each call.
ai.priceHint: A price change applies to new calls: what is already recorded keeps its cost.
ai.promptHint: Describe how the agent behaves. Hard rules (limits, confirmations) are enforced by the code and each company's playbook.
ai.providersHint: Each provider's key lives on the server (environment variable or secrets manager). Here you only see whether it is set: it is never typed or shown.
ai.subtitle: What the assistant uses across all companies. Turning it on, its channels and its playbook are set in each company's record.
ai.supportsToolsHint: Required for an agent that reads or writes in the ERP.
ai.temperatureHint: 0 = always the same; 1 = more varied. For sales, 0.2.
ai.title: Models and agents
ai.toolsHint: What the agent can do in the ERP. Write tools ask the customer for confirmation; the max. amount stops them above that total.
ai.supportsVisionHint: Needed for the agent to understand photos the customer sends.
ai.generatesImagesHint: For the sample images the agent makes over the customer's photo.
ai.imageCostHint: What the provider charges per image; used to compute render costs.
ai.imageModelHint: Makes sample images over the customer's photo. Each company decides in its playbook whether to use them.
ai.archiveMsg: It can't be used for new company agents. Its history is kept and it can be restored.
ai.identityHint: Who Tino is in every company: personality, tone and what it never does. It goes before each type's role and each company's instructions.
ai.identityEmpty: No identity: each agent uses only its type's prompt and its company's instructions.
ai.typesHint: Each agent's role: its prompt, the tools it may use and its default models. Each company creates its agents from a type and can remove tools, change the model and give them instructions.
ai.identityEditHint: Personality, tone and rules Tino shares across all companies. What is specific to a role or company goes in its prompt or instructions.
ai.typeCodeHint: Identifies the type in the system; it can't be changed later.
ai.kindHint: Conversational: serves company channels. Internal: invoked by the system (e.g. summaries).
ai.rolePromptHint: What this agent type does. Tino's identity goes before it and each company's instructions after.
ai.noProviderCodes: All providers the system can call are already registered. A new one needs its integration to be coded.
ai.providerCodeHint: Only those the system can call.
ai.credentialRefHint: The name of the server environment variable. The key goes there, never here.
ai.providerActiveHint: When inactive, its models stop answering. It can't be deactivated while an agent uses them.

cai.enabledHint: When off, WhatsApp messages get no automatic reply and the ERP assistant is unavailable.
cai.escalationHint: Who takes over when the customer asks for a person.
cai.hint: Whether it replies, with which model and tools, on which channels and how it sells.
cai.noModule: The company does not have the AI assistant module
cai.noModuleHint: Add it in «Plan and modules» to set up the assistant and connect WhatsApp.
cai.noWhatsApp: No WhatsApp number: the assistant only works inside the ERP.

offReason.status: Off: the company is neither active nor on trial.

cai.quoteLimitHint: Above it, a salesperson reviews the quote before it is sent.
cai.title: AI assistant
cai.toolsHint: The agent's general tools. Uncheck the ones this company must not use.

companies.search: Search by name, code or tax ID
companies.subtitle: Platform customers and their status
companies.title: Companies

create.adminHint: They get a link to set their password. Nobody else knows it, not even the console.
create.branchHint: The administrator can add more later.
create.codeHint: This is what the customer types at login, next to their email.

err.code: 3 to 20 characters: letters, numbers or hyphens
err.codeTaken: That code is already in use
err.name: Name is required

create.establishmentHint: The one printed on FEL invoices.
create.name: Company name
create.resultDesc: Access code {{code}}. The administrator must activate their account with this link; it is shown only once, so copy it and send it to them.
create.subtitle: It is created with its establishment, one branch and the administrator user.
create.title: New company

detail.adminsHint: Users with the company administrator role.
detail.locationsHint: The company administrator manages them from the app.
detail.newLinkDesc: The previous link no longer works. This one is shown only once.

login.desc: Sign in with your operator account.
login.f2d: What each company uses and its limits
login.f3d: Models, playbooks and channels per company
login.title: Platform console

pb.closeHours: Closes the quote after (hours without activity)
pb.data: Information it asks for before sending the quote
pb.dataHint: Besides the customer and the products, which it always asks for. Saved in the quote notes.
pb.descriptionHint: One or two sentences: the line of business and best sellers.

err.dupKey: There is already a field with that label
err.int0: Integer greater than or equal to 0
err.key: Use letters or numbers in the label
err.label: The label is required

pb.hint: What the agent knows about the business and the rules the code makes it follow. Each save creates a new version.
pb.label: Field
pb.maxAmount: Max. amount it sends on its own (Q)
pb.maxAmountHint: Above it, a salesperson reviews it.
pb.maxAmountShort: Sends on its own up to
pb.none: No playbook: the agent uses the most conservative defaults.
pb.outOfScope: Topics it hands to a person
pb.title: Sales playbook
pb.imagesHint: WhatsApp only. The agent reads photos to quote (it does not keep them) and, if enabled, shows the customer how the quoted item would look on their photo.
pb.photosPerTurnHint: 1 to 5. It ignores the rest and tells the customer.
pb.rendersHint: Before the first one it asks for all design details. It only shows what is being quoted.
pb.rendersMaxHint: 1 to 5. Each one has a cost, even if the customer does not approve it.
pb.warnNoVision: This company's model cannot read images: the agent will tell the customer it cannot see them.
pb.warnNoImageModel: The sales agent has no image model: choose one in «Models and agents».
pb.newProductsAllowHint: They go to Inventory › To review; a salesperson confirms the price.
pb.linesHint: ERP categories, one per line. Empty = any existing one.
pb.outOfLine: What it says if outside its lines
pb.outOfLineHint: Empty = a friendly message that they don't make it.
pb.newProductsLines: Proposes them if they belong to: {{l}}
pb.confirmHint: What the agent asks before moving on. Fewer questions make the conversation faster; keep the ones that commit the customer.
pb.confirmData: Asks again about what the customer already said
pb.confirmDataHint: Off: if they say “blue”, blue is noted and the agent moves on.
pb.confirmPhotoNo: Not confirmed (the sales rep checks them)
pb.confirmDesignFlexible: “I like it” or “looks good” is enough
pb.confirmSend: Asks for confirmation before sending the quote
pb.confirmSendHint: One summary with everything and one question. Recommended.
pb.confirmApprove: Asks for confirmation to approve by text
pb.confirmApproveHint: Repeats number and total. Recommended: it is a purchase commitment.
pb.confirmReject: Asks for confirmation to reject by text
pb.confirmReopen: Asks before reopening a sent quote
pb.confirmReopenHint: Off: the customer asking to change it is the confirmation.
pb.confirmNotesHint: Optional. For example: “Don't ask about the color twice”.
pb.styleHint: How the agent writes. Short, direct messages are less tiring for the customer.
pb.styleRepeat: Repeats the quote summary in every message
pb.styleRepeatHint: Off: the summary goes once, before sending or if the customer asks.
pb.styleOneTopic: One topic and one question per message
pb.styleNotesHint: Optional. For example: “Greet by name”, “Use formal you”.
pb.newProductsAlways: If the agent has the “new product” tool, it creates the product from what the customer asked for and builds the preliminary quote. It goes to Inventory › To review and a sales rep confirms the price.
pb.linesHintCategory: Optional. ERP categories, one per line: the agent uses the one that fits to classify it.
pb.styleAskData: When it asks for customer details
pb.styleAskDataHint: Name, phone and tax ID. At the end: the customer first says what they want and the products wait.
pb.styleAskEnd: At the end, once it knows what they want

plans.activeHint: Turning it off does not affect companies that already have it.
plans.codeHint: Internal identifier; it cannot change later.

err.code: Lowercase letters, numbers or underscore; 2 to 30 characters
err.price: Amount in quetzales, up to 2 decimals

plans.name: Name
plans.priceHint: What a company on this plan pays; a different price can be agreed in its record.
plans.subtitle: What each plan includes. Per-company exceptions are set on the company page.
plans.title: Plans and modules

statusDlg.effActive: The company regains access to the app and its agent.
statusDlg.effCancelled: Like suspending, but final. Data is not deleted.
statusDlg.effSuspended: Nobody in the company can sign in and its agent stops answering. It can be reactivated.
statusDlg.reasonHint: It is kept in the company history.
statusDlg.title: Change status

sub.hint: What the company can use in the ERP and with which limits.
sub.inactivePlan: This plan is no longer offered to new companies.
sub.planChangeHint: When the plan changes, modules reset to the new plan.
sub.title: Plan and modules

usage.detailHint: This month's consumption, its direct cost and the margin against what the company pays.
usage.detailHintNoMoney: This month's consumption against the plan limits.
usage.empty: No company operated in this month
usage.nearHint: At 80 % or more of their plan limit. Consider offering a bigger plan or a custom limit.
usage.noAi: No AI messages in this month.
usage.partial: Current month: data up to today.
usage.subtitle: Consumption, direct cost and margin of each company in the month.
usage.subtitleNoMoney: Consumption of each company in the month and limits about to be reached.
usage.title: Usage and costs
usage.waNote: WhatsApp templates (messages outside the 24 h window) are not sent yet; once they exist, their cost is added here.

wa.disconnectMsg: The agent stops replying on this number right away. Its conversations are kept and you can connect it again.
wa.notConfigured: VITE_META_APP_ID and VITE_META_CONFIG_ID are not set in the console.
wa.note: The number cannot be in use in the WhatsApp app on a phone.
wa.step1: Meta's window opens. Whoever manages the business signs in with their Facebook account.
wa.step2: They pick or create their WhatsApp Business account and verify the number with a code.
wa.step3: The number goes under Stackline's app and the sales agent starts replying. The token is stored on the server; nobody sees it.
wa.title: Connect WhatsApp
wa.connectHint: The number must belong to Stackline’s WhatsApp Business account. Its ID is in Meta › WhatsApp › API Setup (“Phone number ID”).
wa.agentHint: Without an agent, the number does not reply.
wa.inUse: Another company already uses this number. Disconnect it there first.
wa.already: Already connected to this company: connecting only changes the agent.

err.id: The number ID is digits only.

wa.sectionHint: Numbers from Stackline’s WhatsApp Business account that this company uses.
wa.empty: The company has no WhatsApp numbers connected.

ta.title: AI agents
ta.hint: Tino's agents in this company: which channel each one serves, with what model and tools, their instructions and playbook.
ta.enabledHint: When off, no company agent answers on any channel.
ta.archiveMsg: It stops serving its channels right now. Its conversations and history are kept.
ta.noModule: The company doesn't have the AI Assistant module: add it in «Plan and modules» so its agents can answer.
ta.policyOff: The assistant is off for the whole company.
ta.empty: The company has no agents. Create one from a type (e.g. Sales) and assign its channels.
ta.instructionsHint: What is specific to this agent in this company: its processes, what to offer and what not. It goes after Tino's identity and the type's role, and prevails over them.
ta.instructionsEmpty: No instructions: the agent uses Tino's identity, its type's role and the playbook.
ta.typeHint: Defines the role and the tools it may use. It can't be changed later.
ta.name: Name
ta.nameHint: To tell it apart in the company, e.g. «Sales WhatsApp» or «Sales Web».
ta.imageHint: If the company doesn't want sample images, turn them off in the playbook or remove the render tool.
ta.channelsHint: A channel is served by a single agent: checking it here takes it from the previous one.
ta.noChannels: The company has no channels yet.
ta.activeHint: When off, its channels get no automatic reply.

web.name: Name
web.nameHint: Only for the console, e.g. “Online store”.
web.agentHint: Without an agent, the chat does not reply.
web.noAgents: Create an agent for the company first.
web.originsHint: One per line, with https://. Use https://*.example.com for all its subdomains. The chat does not load on any other site.
web.title: Title
web.greetingHint: First message the visitor sees when opening the chat. Optional.
web.activeHint: When off, the chat disappears from the page.
web.codeHint: Paste it on the company’s page, right before </body>. The chat shows up at the bottom right.
web.codeOptions: Optional: data-position="left" moves it to the left and data-open="true" opens it on load.
web.noPublicUrl: AGENT_PUBLIC_URL is missing in agents-services: the code cannot be built without the public address.
web.sectionHint: A widget the company pastes on its site. Visitors chat without signing up; the agent asks for their details when they want a quote.
web.empty: The company has no chat on its website.
web.showPricesHint: The “Your quote” panel shows prices and total. Off: only products and quantities; the price comes with the PDF.

err.label: Type {{n}}: name of 1 to 40 characters
err.code: Type {{n}}: lowercase code, no spaces (e.g. pergola)
err.product: Type {{n}}: the ERP product ID is missing
err.whatsapp: Number with country code, digits only (e.g. 50212345678)

pln.nameHint: Only for the console, e.g. “Pergola planner”.
pln.agentHint: Chats with the visitor. Without an agent it works with no chat or renders.
pln.originsHint: One per line, with https://. From any other site the planner does not load.
pln.typesHint: The chips the visitor sees. Each one points to a product in the company ERP; if it has a calculation template, it is priced to size.
pln.fitHint: Fits up to this % of the budget; from there to 100 %, “right at budget”; above, “over budget”.
pln.whatsappHint: With country code. The “Contact an advisor” button opens this WhatsApp with the design written out. Empty: no button.
pln.rendersHint: Renders come from the agent playbook (example images: on/off and how many) and its image model.
pln.activeHint: Off, the planner disappears from the page.
pln.codeHint: Paste it into the company page, where the planner should appear.
pln.codeOptions: Optional: data-accent="#RRGGBB" changes the color on that page. Works with smooth scroll (Lenis) out of the box.
pln.sectionHint: A block on the company page: the visitor builds options with real prices against their budget and contacts an advisor on WhatsApp. It does not create quotes.
pln.empty: The company has no planner on its website.
pln.categoriesHint: Visitors pick a category and then a product from the list, with its photo and price. Each category includes its subcategories.
pln.noCatalog: The company's ERP catalog could not be read. Try again in a moment.
pln.emptyCatalog: The company has no categories in its ERP yet.
pln.legacyTypesHint: Chips that point to a product with a calculation template (quoted to measure). You can remove them if you use categories.
